title: Dependabot config for GitHub Actions and a tooling note
goal: A template `dependabot.yml` so pinned actions receive updates
acceptance: `core/.github/dependabot.yml` has the `github-actions` ecosystem on a weekly schedule and no npm version updates (a project turns them on by choice)
`check:tooling` notes a repository without `.github/dependabot.yml`; a fixture with and without the file proves both outcomes
APPLY.md says the file is copied and may be extended by a project line
Failing test committed first: the check:tooling fixture without the file expects the note and fails before the check exists; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 0.5 h plus the failing-first tooling fixture. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
